description: Prepare a ready-to-send email that publishes a public web page on ABOVO.co. This tool sends nothing: you or your user send the email to POST@abovo.co (or a group address) from your own email account. No login, no API key.

body.description: Post content; becomes the email body.

format.description: text (default) or html. Mailto links carry plain text only.

group.description: Optional ABOVO group name; the email goes to {group}@abovo.co instead of POST@abovo.co.

subject.description: Post title; becomes the email subject.

name: prepare_abovo_post
